Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Guard - Armed Clearance Required Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. Join Allied Universal as an Armed Security Officer supporting a dynamic aerospace and defense location. You will conduct routine patrols, operate a vehicle in accordance with AU Driver Policy requirements, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and respond to security-related concerns with professionalism. This role calls for exceptional customer service, clear communication, teamwork, integrity, and an active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance.

Position Type: Part Time

 Pay Rate: $22.13 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeWed06:00 AM - 02:00 PMThur06:00 AM - 02:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to personnel, visitors, and contractors at an aerospace and defense location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.

About us

We are a local security company looking for loyal and committed workers to serve our clients all around the San Antonio and surrounding areas. *We have immediate positions for hire* and pay weekly! Serious applicants only please who are willing to work night shifts and use their own vehicle.

jobs.title: Security Specialist/HARPS Guard I - PT On Call Floater hours
jobs.description:
Position: PART-TIME PT Floater hours


SCHEDULE: on-call floater hours


Specific Tasks. The following tasks are general duties for the HARPS personnel. Contracting Personnel (CP) providing service at JBSA-Lackland and Randolph, AFB shall perform the following tasks below;

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: • Monitor all electromagnetic door locks, door contact switches, duress alarms and answer all telephone calls within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. This area is defined as the Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) room, and the adjacent administrative area commonly referred to as the Information Desk. • Personnel will monitor the Identipass, Genetech, and Premisys access control systems. • Initial training for these systems will be provided by a company representative of which the system is being provided by. The contractor will then be responsible to train any new CP thereafter. • The government will phase out any of the systems that will eventually no longer be in use. • Operate, observe and evaluate CCTVs within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. • Use the Government provided radio system to notify the Facility Management staff and/or the base installation Security Forces on any alarm or police response situations. • Monitor operations and status of overall security network for the MTF from the centralized console. • Operate HARPS/Information Desk intercom system master station at the console to communicate with entry/exit points or incident locations. • Utilize overhead paging system to notify personnel of emergency codes and alarms. Communicate all information in a clear and concise manner. • Operate video recorder and playback at the request of Facility Management personnel. • Maintain security log and activate control devices for interior and exterior doors. • Receive transfer calls from designated wing agencies and take messages or forward calls to appropriate agencies. • Report and initiate an action report log on any emergency situation and provide comprehensive information to responding agencies and Facility Management staff when appropriate. • Maintain up to date roster of on-call and emergency contact personnel for required areas. • The CP report to an appropriate authority (DCS Supervisors, Security Forces, and Facility Managers) any information or circumstances, which may pose a threat to the security of DoD personnel, contractor personnel, resources, and classified or unclassified defense information. • Maintain Chronology of Events, Access Control logs and Alarm Reports at all times. Event logs will be documented in a professional manner utilizing appropriate grammar and punctuation and include all pertinent information covering the parameters of “Who, What, When, and Where.” Event logs will be sent to Facility Management on a daily basis no later than 0800 hrs. These documents are for official use only. • CP shall perform and document physical checks of assigned buildings, rooms and areas when electronic systems are degraded. This includes manual fire watch procedures when fire alarm systems are down and checks of controlled areas such as pharmacies when Intrution Detection Systems (IDS) are degraded. • Act as the information focal point for all medical groups' personnel, patients and visitors on all resource protection activities and the liaison on these issues to the facility management office.


Qualifications.

  1. Have 12 months of experience as an alarm monitor or dispatcher, either in the military or civilian sector, within the last 3 years.
  2. Skills and Knowledge. Must be able to use, at minimum, Access Control System, Genetech, and Microsoft Programs such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  3. Shall be capable of sitting for an extended period of time during the course of their 8-hour shift, but are able to get up and move about within the area. CP shall be capable of bending, reaching, and lifting a minimum of 30 pounds to move and retrieve records or equipment, and may require prolonged walking and or standing.
  4. Personnel must be able to communicate in a clear and concise manner and demonstrate a calm demeanor during high-stress situations

jobs.title: Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Hotels & Resorts, and more. As a Patrol Unarmed Officer at a hotel and resort location, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide welcoming customer service to guests and staff. You will communicate clearly, respond to security-related concerns, and support a positive environment. Join Allied Universal, where agility, reliability, innovation, teamwork, and integrity guide our people-first culture.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $15.67 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeWed10:00 PM - 06:00 AMThur10:00 PM - 06:00 AMFri10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSat10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide exceptional customer service to guests, visitors, and staff while carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities at a hotel and resort location.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of guest areas, entrances, parking areas, amenities, and the property perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity and identify potential concerns.
  • Respond to incidents, guest concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established reporting and escalation procedures.
  • Monitor access points and observe activity throughout the property, reporting unusual conditions, maintenance concerns, and policy violations to appropriate personnel.
  • Complete accurate activity logs, incident reports, and shift documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and site-specific requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • A Guard Card or license is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices. C15802

jobs.title: Security Supervisor
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Under general direction, is responsible for performing supervisory and administrative work coordinating the activities of assigned security force to include contract security guards. Exercises direct supervision over assigned staff.

Work Location

900 E Market Street, San Antonio, TX 78205

Work Schedule

Monday - Friday 7:00 A.M. - 3:30 P.M. (Rotating days off)

Adjusted hours, holidays, and weekends depending on events

Essential Job Functions

  • Develops operating procedures, policies, and directives.
  • Coordinates work assignments.
  • Prepares reports and maintains records regarding incidents.
  • Investigates and takes appropriate action on resident complaints.
  • Performs administrative functions related to counseling, performance evaluations, employee discipline, hiring, training, etc.
  • Prepares budget for section.
  • Opens and secures assigned buildings.
  • Responds to building intrusion alarm activations.
  • Examines and certifies portable fire extinguishing equipment.
  • Performs related duties and fulfills responsibilities as required.

Job Requirements

  • Associate's Degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Three (3) years law enforcement or security experience, including two (2) years supervisory experience.
  • Valid Class "C" Texas Driver's License
  • Must be certified in CPR or become certified within one year of appointment.

Applicant Information

  • Unless otherwise stated, applicants are permitted to substitute two years of related full-time experience for one year of higher education or one year of related higher education for two years of experience in order to meet the minimum requirements of the job. One year of full-time experience is defined as 30 or more hours worked per week for 12 months. One year of higher education is defined as 30 credit hours completed at an accredited college or university.
  • Applicants selected for employment with the City of San Antonio in this position must receive satisfactory results from pre-employment drug testing and background checks. If required for the position, a physical, motor vehicle record evaluation, and additional background checks may be conducted.
  • Please be advised that if selected for this position, information regarding employment history as it relates to the qualifications of the position will be needed for employment verification. Applicants claiming military service to meet the experience requirement for this position may attach a DD214 to the application.
  • If selected for this position, official transcripts, diplomas, certifications, and licenses must be submitted at the time of processing. Unofficial transcripts and copies of other relevant documents may be attached to the application for consideration in advance.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Knowledge of modern security procedures, techniques, methods, and practices.
  • Knowledge of administrative and management practices.
  • Skill in utilizing a personal computer and associated software programs.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to act quickly and calmly in emergency situations.
  • Ability to establish and maintain good public relations skills.
  • Ability to respond to minor troubleshooting of intrusion alarm and fire alarm reporting systems and equipment.
  • Ability to perform all physical requirements of the position, with or without accommodations.
  • Working conditions are primarily in an office environment. Working conditions are in a large building complex or stadium environment with occasional exposure to hostile people and emergency situations.

Benefits Information

The City of San Antonio (CoSA) strives to provide a competitive compensation and benefit package to attract and retain a highly skilled workforce. To accomplish this, CoSA offers subsidized health care benefits for active and retired employees, paid disability benefits, paid life insurance, as well as automatic participation in a pension program which is currently matched two to one.

For more detailed information, please click on the following link to view Benefits offered by the City of San Antonio:

http://www.sanantonio.gov/hr/employee_information/benefits/index.asp

Note

  • Part-Time, Temporary, and non-City positions are not eligible for CoSA Benefits.
  • Holiday and Leave benefits for Pre-K 4 SA positions may be different than what is listed at the above link.

Additional Information

The City Of San Antonio is an Equal Opportunity/Reasonable Accommodation Employer. This means that the City does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, sex (gender), age, disability, national origin, genetic information, or sexual orientation. All individuals are encouraged to apply and compete for jobs with the City of San Antonio.

If you require assistance at any stage of the application process due to a disability, please contact the Human Resources Department so that accommodations may be made to meet your needs. Our telephone number is 210-207-8705 and our fax number is 210-207-2285.
